items.title: Google Rethink ROI Summit: Merchant AI Adoption Metrics Meet the Agent Commerce Reality

items.title: That Dip In Lululemon Stock Looks Cheap, But What If Leggings Keep Sliding?
items.summary: Lululemon Athletica (LULU) has fallen about 22% since late August and now trades at its lowest price in the past year. Is that a chance to buy? Its own record says dips here have paid off more often than not. The catch is that the recent ones have not. And Lululemon's own women's leggings sales, in a category it leads, fell about 20% in fiscal Q2 2026.
